title: One Lap Each
can_do: 游戏规则不公平时，提出“怎么样才公平”的修改方案。

conversation_move.label: negotiate a fairer rule for a game

trigger: The truck game rule feels unfair, so Child proposes a taking-turns rule.
setting: Playroom floor with the truck track.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I want to be the driver every time!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Every time is not fair for me.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: But it's my truck and my track.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: How about you drive first, then me after one lap?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: One lap is so long though.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay, one fast lap each, then we switch.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: One lap each... that sounds fair.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: And we both say switch out loud, so nobody forgets.

replay_cards.title: Castle colors
replay_cards.setting: Building a block castle with Max.
replay_cards.change: Max wants all the red blocks.
replay_cards.challenge: Child proposes taking turns by color — red for the roof, blue for the walls — and Max agrees to a fair split.

replay_cards.title: The finish line
replay_cards.change: They argue about where the finish line is.
replay_cards.challenge: Child proposes the big tree as the finish line and adds a rematch rule so the loser picks the next game.

parent_support: 和同伴玩时大人退后，只在僵持时提示“能想个两人都行的办法吗”。
孩子提出规则后帮他确认：“你们都说好了吗？”让协议立住。
换局时提醒执行约定，让“说出口的规则”真的算数。
